en.name: NearServe
en.short_description: Find local plumbers, electricians, tutors and more from OpenStreetMap
en.subtitle: Local services directory
en.description:
NearServe finds local service providers near a town or postcode you choose: plumbers, electricians, cleaners, hairdressers, mechanics, doctors and dentists, tutors, vets, lawyers, caterers, movers and gyms. Listings are real businesses from OpenStreetMap, the community-built map. Nothing is invented: anything OpenStreetMap does not publish is shown as not published.

FIND
Pick a category or search for a trade. Each listing shows what OpenStreetMap contributors have published: address, phone number, website, opening hours and distance from your area. Tap to call or to open the website. OpenStreetMap carries no prices or ratings, so NearServe shows none: no price, no cost estimate and no star rating appears for these listings.

PLAN
For a business that publishes regular opening hours, pick a time inside those hours and keep it in your Bookings. NearServe does not contact the business or make a reservation for you. Call them to arrange it.

AFTER
Your planned appointments live in one place. Once an appointment time has passed you can write a review of it; reviews are stored on your device only.

SAVED
Keep the providers you would use again. Everything you save stays on your device, and NearServe has no account.

ADS
NearServe shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not ask to track you across other companies' apps, and in regions that require it ads are only requested after you give consent, which you can change at any time under Settings > Privacy choices.

Listing data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
NearServe finds local service providers near a town or postcode you choose: plumbers, electricians, cleaners, hairdressers, mechanics, doctors and dentists, tutors, vets, lawyers, caterers, movers and gyms. Listings are real businesses from OpenStreetMap, the community-built map. Nothing is invented: anything OpenStreetMap does not publish is shown as not published.

Intended audience:
Local services directory

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google AdMob (ads). Banner and interstitial ads; Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. Non-tracking: the app does not request App Tracking Transparency. Google's UMP consent form is shown where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) and can be reopened from Settings > Privacy choices.
- OpenStreetMap public services (Overpass API for listings, Nominatim for the area search). No personal data is sent; bookings, reviews and saved providers stay on the device.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

NearServe lists real local service businesses from OpenStreetMap around a town or postcode the user chooses, by category or by trade search, with the address, phone, website and opening hours OpenStreetMap publishes. Planned appointments and reviews are saved on the device only and are not sent to the business.

7. CODE SHARED WITH OUR OTHER APPS
Yes, infrastructure only: agl_i18n (shared translations); agl_observability (crash reporting); agl_ads (Google AdMob ads and consent). It has no sign-in and uses no backend of ours; listings come from the public OpenStreetMap services. No screens, features or content are shared; the similarity figure in 5 measures exactly that.

8. CODE SHARED WITH THIRD-PARTY APPS
No, beyond standard third-party frameworks: dio, flutter_localizations, flutter_riverpod, flutter_secure_storage, google_fonts, google_mobile_ads, shared_preferences, url_launcher. Listing data comes from OpenStreetMap under the ODbL and is credited in the app.
